llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define a key builder (for example `buildProductsQueryKey(filter, page, pageSize)`) that returns `['products', filter, page, pageSize] as const`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No `buildProductsQueryKey` function is defined. The query key is inlined directly as `['products', filter, page, PAGE_SIZE]` without a dedicated builder function.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Query key entries must remain primitive/serializable (`'products'`, filter string, page number, pageSize number) with no functions or object references.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: All query key members are primitives: string literal 'products', filter string, page number, PAGE_SIZE number. No functions or object references.

`queryFn` is `() => fetchProducts(filter, page)`, closing over component state directly. It does not accept a `QueryFunctionContext` parameter nor destructure `activeFilter`, `activePage`, or `activePageSize` from `queryKey`.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use TanStack Query v5 object-form APIs (`useQuery({ ... })`, client object filters), not legacy positional signatures.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses TanStack Query v5 object-form `useQuery({ queryKey, queryFn, placeholderData })` and `@tanstack/react-query` v5 (`^5.90.21`).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must set `placeholderData` as `(previous) => previous` to keep previous page/category data visible during refetch.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `placeholderData` is set to the imported `keepPreviousData` sentinel, not to the identity function `(previous) => previous` as required.
